item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently establishes when the tariff amendments apply to covered articles, directly determining their legal applicability beginning January 1, 1967.","evidence":"the amendments to the Tariff Schedules of the United States made by section 3 (a) of the Joint Resolution shall apply"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President designates the United States Information Agency to administer the agreement and assigns it authority to make required determinations and regulations, without dictating their substantive outcomes.","evidence":"the United States Information Agency is hereby designated as the agency to carry out the provisions of the Agreement and related protocol"}]}
